chunks: 5171 - Samāʿah asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.
"And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell."

He عليه السلام said: "Whoever kills a believer on account of his religion, that is the intentional killer about whom Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said in His Book: and He has prepared for him a great punishment."
I said: "Then a man may have something occur between him and another man, so he strikes him with his sword and kills him."
He عليه السلام said: "That is not the intentional killing which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, referred to."

key_terms.جَهَنَّمُ: Hell; the threatened recompense in the verse
key_terms.عَذَابًا عَظِيمًا: a tremendous punishment prepared by Allah
key_terms.عَلَى دِينِهِ: because of his religion; on account of his faith
key_terms.مُؤْمِنًا: a believer; the protected person whose killing is under discussion

ai.seo_question: What does the verse about intentionally killing a believer mean in Imam al-Sadiq’s عليه السلام explanation?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur’anic threat concerning one who kills a believer intentionally as referring to killing a believer because of his religion. It distinguishes that grave, faith-targeted murder from a killing arising out of a personal clash, clarifying the verse’s specific meaning and the severity of religiously motivated killing.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5171 - Samaah asked Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about the saying of Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic:
"And whoever kills a believer intentionally, his recompense is Hell" (Surah An-Nisa 4:93).

Imam (as) said: "Whoever kills a believer because of his faith, that is the intentional killer whom Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic, mentioned in His (swt) Book and for whom He (swt) has prepared a great punishment."
I asked: "What about a man who has a dispute with another man, and in the heat of the moment strikes him with a sword and kills him?"
Imam (as) said: "That is not the intentional killing that Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic, referred to."
